units.normalized_content: Declares RAHU v0.1.0 as adversarial benchmark for parameter drift, representation shift, rule inversion and attribution ambiguity across baseline and ARC agents.
Defines normalized D_R/B_D/F_S regime config, default four-shock suite, agent defaults, evaluation flags, complete RAHU config and default RAHU-0 seed 42 construction.
Declares controlled benchmark environments exposing observations, reward/loss, regime/shock metadata and ground-truth failure labels and exports four current shock environments plus base.

Synthetic ambiguity environment: after shock, targets probabilistically resemble parameter drift (3x) or operator shift (theta x^2); metadata depth .90/breadth .85 and ground truth is 'ambiguous'; source predicts holding under uncertainty.
Defines StepResult(observation,reward,terminated,truncated,info), ground-truth ShockMetadata, abstract reset/step/inject_shock/failure-layer interface and regime/step/shock accessors.
Synthetic parameter shock y=2x→3x; step samples x and returns reward=-|prediction-target|; shock metadata failure_layer=parameter, depth=.10, breadth=.10.

Synthetic representation shock activates sign(x)*sqrt(|x|) encoding while source frames functional relation as preserved; target=theta×encoded; metadata failure_layer=representation, depth=.40, breadth=.35.
Synthetic operator shock changes rule y=theta x to theta x^2 while keeping theta/observation space; metadata failure_layer=operator, depth=.75, breadth=.70.

Defines experiment container/runner, seeded RNG and EpisodeRecorder; intended step obtains environment observation, calls agent.act, calls environment.step, records transition; run loops episodes and returns telemetry with metrics={} and seed/agent metadata.
Runner explicitly delegates metric computation and returns an empty metrics dictionary.
Declares reproducible shock/regime generation and attempts exports ShockGenerator and CurriculumGenerator.

Defines D_R/B_D/F_S regime object and deterministic/random/interpolated ecologies; shallow metadata predicts flat_optimizer, transitional labels expected AAR≈1 region, deep metadata predicts ARC—these are source expectations, not observations.
Defines four canonical shock types and immutable shock metadata; canonical depths/breadths .10/.10, .40/.35, .75/.70, .90/.85; supports seeded random/configurable generation.
Declares raw experiment telemetry as collection/storage rather than metric interpretation and exports TelemetryEvent, TelemetryLogger and EpisodeRecorder.
Defines immutable generic, attribution, governance and environment telemetry event dataclasses.
Stores in-memory telemetry events, supports generic event creation, filtering/latest/clear, dictionary export and basic event-count/type summary.
Wraps telemetry logger for an episode and records environment, attribution, governance, generic transition and intervention events; exposes trajectory/export/reset.
